question:
Select the option in which the given figure is embedded. (Rotation is NOT allowed)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cddc999df6604f8d958deeaf614f613e3692b0ac96b164fb68891753f8272128.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

We consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3de114cd1c0c7789cff3384eaae508f8cb5e6aa5f4feb019c4b001ccd789b0b.png] The figure is rotated which is not allowed.

Option 2) The figure cannot be embedded.

Option 3) The figure can be embedded.

Option 4) The figure is rotated which is not allowed.

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**
